        - paragraph: "A function is increasing where outputs rise as x moves right, and decreasing where outputs fall.       - article:
        - heading "Rule (Derivative Test)" [level=3]
        - paragraph: If f′(x)>0 on an interval, f is increasing there.
        - paragraph: If f′(x)<0, f is decreasing there.
        - paragraph: If f′ changes from + to − at c ⇒ local maximum.
        - paragraph: If f′ changes from − to + at c ⇒ local minimum.
      - article:
        - heading "ⓘ One worked example" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Find where f(x)=−3x³+x² increases or decreases.
        - paragraph: 1) f′(x)=−9x²+2x=x(−9x+2)
        - paragraph: 2) f′(x)=0 ⇒ x=0, 2/9
        - paragraph: "3) Sign: − on (−∞,0), + on (0,2/9), − on (2/9,∞)"
      - article:
        - heading "⚠ Common misconception" [level=3]
        - paragraph: "Misconception: f′(x)=0 ⇒ f has an extreme value at x."
        - paragraph: "Truth: f′(x)=0 is only a candidate. Check the sign change."
        - paragraph:
          - text: + to − ⇒ local max
          - text: − to + ⇒ local min
          - text: No sign change ⇒ no extremum.
